tools.name: submit_call_result
tools.description: Save the final result of the call. Call exactly once, after the caller confirmed a viewing time or once it is clear no viewing will be booked, and before saying goodbye.

outcome.description: booked only if the caller explicitly said yes when you repeated back a viewing time fully inside a free window. Otherwise not_booked: no agreement, a time outside the windows, maybe, a call back, the caller has to check, or the call ending early.

viewing_start.description: Agreed viewing start as ISO 8601 with the Europe/Prague offset, in the same form as the free window times, for example 2026-11-14T10:30:00+01:00. Set only when outcome is booked. Leave out when not booked.

answers.description: One item per open question asked during the call. Empty list when none were asked.

items.description: A question and the caller's answer.

question.description: The open question, as listed in the prompt.

answer.description: What the caller said, in a few words. Use unknown when they did not know or did not answer.

new_costs.description: Costs the caller mentioned that are not in the fact sheet. Leave out a cost with no stated amount and mention it in the summary instead. Empty list when there are none.

items.description: One cost with a stated amount.

label.description: Short name of the cost, for example parking or internet.

recurring.description: true when the cost repeats monthly, false when it is paid once.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what happened in the call, with the reason when not booked.

tools.name: mark_question_asked
tools.description: Tick an open question on the screen. Call right after you asked that open question aloud, once per question. Do not mention it and do not wait for a result.

number.description: The 1-based number of the open question in the numbered list of open questions.
